scripts.title: Fake Premium n Verified
scripts.script:
local LocalPlayer = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer

local premium, verified = true, true
local Index; Index = hookmetamethod(game, "__index", newcclosure(function(self, key)
    if self == LocalPlayer then
        if premium and key == "MembershipType" then
            return Enum.MembershipType.Premium
        end
        if verified and key == "HasVerifiedBadge" then
            return true
        end
    end
    return Index(self, key)
end))
